notes.title: Lift Attendant 1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
New Features:
- Added a new game mode, Scenario! In Scenario mode, you are provided a set of pre upgraded elevators to use and upgrades are no longer available. Without the worries of having to upgrade, you can focus purely on transporting passengers
- Added Leaderboards for Scenario Mode
- Added initial elevator details in level introduction window
- Display Best and Average global leaderboard times in-game
- Added new Steam Achievement for completing all Scenario levels

Improvements/Enhancements:
- Changed displayed time to seconds to be consistent with leaderboards

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed bug with ESC hotkey not working in Main Menu Leaderboard view
- Fixed bug with some sounds not respecting the volume settings

notes.title: Lift Attendant v1.0.8 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Added a restart level button on the game menu
- Reduced difficulty for some levels by increasing time limit
